overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: Facebook posts showed no quorum deliberation, and the civility and blocking complaints fall outside the Division's review. No remedy was ordered.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly deliberated outside a posted meeting via Facebook posts and comments among members.
allegations.key_passage: We have reviewed the Facebook posts provided to us by the complainant and find no evidence that the posts involved communication directed to a quorum of the Board or that Board members responded to the posts of members.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board's social media writing was harassing and showed unprofessional conduct and lack of ethics.
allegations.key_passage: An allegation of unprofessional conduct or incivility towards town employees or members of the public does not constitute a violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board blocked her from seeing and responding to comments on town-related Facebook pages.
allegations.key_passage: Moreover, any concerns with the Board blocking individuals from posting comments would also be outside the scope of the Division’s review
